# Fixture Shop

A tiny webshop where shoppers browse a catalog and buy products, and store admins manage the resulting orders.

## Intent

Exercise the complete pdd-kit report contract with a small deterministic product.

## Teaching note

This supporting section exercises lossless Product Report expansion.
